qp_list_recent_intakes.name: List recent POV intake submissions
qp_list_recent_intakes.serves: Traceable only to the provided intake artifact context and need to review incomplete submissions; no explicit use case/user story exists in InitialPOVSpec.
qp_list_recent_intakes.for: Retrieve recent POV intake records for operational review.

qp_list_intakes_by_status.name: List POV intakes by status
qp_list_intakes_by_status.serves: Traceable to the need implied by open_questions/review context to manage incomplete and clarification-needed POVs; no explicit use case/user story exists in InitialPOVSpec.
qp_list_intakes_by_status.for: Retrieve POV intake records filtered by workflow status, most recently updated first.

qp_get_intake_detail.name: Get POV intake detail
qp_get_intake_detail.serves: Traceable to the provided incomplete intake artifact and open questions requiring detailed review; no explicit use case/user story exists in InitialPOVSpec.
qp_get_intake_detail.for: Fetch the full intake record, including raw spec, review result, assumptions, open questions, and success criteria, for a single POV submission.

qp_list_open_questions_for_intake.name: List open questions for a POV intake
qp_list_open_questions_for_intake.for: Return only the open questions and their statuses for a specific intake so reviewers can see what clarification is still needed.

qp_list_unresolved_questions_across_inta.name: List unresolved clarification questions across POV intakes
qp_list_unresolved_questions_across_inta.serves: Traceable to InitialPOVSpec.open_questions and the authoritative embedded open_questions model.
qp_list_unresolved_questions_across_inta.for: Find all open questions still unresolved across incomplete or clarification-needed POV submissions.

qp_summary_counts_by_status.name: Summarize POV intakes by status
qp_summary_counts_by_status.serves: Traceable to the review workflow implied by the intake artifact status field in the authoritative data model; no explicit use case/user story exists in InitialPOVSpec.
qp_summary_counts_by_status.for: Provide an operational summary of how many POV intakes are incomplete, need clarification, or are ready for redesign.
